lesson: Height and depth are independent coordinates of the dual of R_{>0} x Z_p^x: the analytic conductor is p^k(1+|t|), a product, and the two twists never substitute. Integers below N supply multiplicative relations (Prouhet-Tarry-Escott products, congruent mod H^r) that are trivial p-adically and non-trivial at the real place as soon as N exceeds about (q|t|)^(1/r). A periodic family cannot carry a height by approximating n^(-it); U is separated from periodic characters by this lemma, which is an obstruction for the device, not a handle on zeta.
